11:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;

15:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
16: 
17:   let playerY = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
18:   let velocityY = 0;
19:   let isJumping = false;
20:   let obstacles = [];
21:   let lastSpawn = 0;
22:   let gameOver = false;

24:   function reset() {
25:     playerY = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
26:     velocityY = 0;
27:     obstacles = [];
28:     lastSpawn = performance.now();
29:     gameOver = false;
30:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
31:   }
32: 
33:   function spawnObstacle() {
34:     const gapHeight = Math.random() * 80 + 40; // height of gap from bottom
35:     const size = Math.random() * 40 + 20; // obstacle thickness
36:     obstacles.push({x: width, w: size, gapY: gapHeight});
37:   }
38: 
39:   function update(dt) {
40:     // player physics
41:     if (isJumping) {
42:       velocityY = JUMP_VELOCITY;
43:       isJumping = false;
44:     }
45:     velocityY += GRAVITY;
46:     playerY += velocityY;
47:     if (playerY > height - PLAYER_SIZE) {
48:       playerY = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
49:       velocityY = 0;
50:     }
51:     // obstacles
52:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= OBSTACLE_SPEED);
53:     // remove offscreen
54:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
55:     // spawn new
56:     const now = performance.now();
57:     if (now - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
58:       spawnObstacle();
59:       lastSpawn = now;
60:     }
61:     // collision
62:     for (const o of obstacles) {
63:       if (PLAYER_X + PLAYER_SIZE > o.x && PLAYER_X < o.x + o.w) {
64:         // check if player is in the gap
65:         if (playerY + PLAYER_SIZE > height - o.gapY) {
66:           gameOver = true;
67:           break;
68:         }
69:       }
70:     }
71:   }
72: 
73:   function draw() {
74:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
75:     // background
76:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
77:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
78:     // player
79:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
80:     ctx.fillRect(PLAYER_X, playerY, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE);
81:     // obstacles (upper part, leaving gap at bottom)
82:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
83:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
84:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, 0, o.w, height - o.gapY);
85:     });
86:     // game over overlay
87:     if (gameOver) {
88:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
89:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
90:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
91:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
92:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
93:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
94:     }
95:   }
96: 
97:   let lastTime = 0;
98:   function loop(timestamp) {
99:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
100:     lastTime = timestamp;
101:     if (!gameOver) {
102:       update(dt);
103:     }
104:     draw();
105:     if (!gameOver) {
106:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
107:     } else {
108:       // restart on click
109:       canvas.addEventListener('click', reset, {once: true});
110:       canvas.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') reset(); }, {once: true});
111:     }
112:   }
113: 
114:   // input handling
115:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => { isJumping = true; });
116:   canvas.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') isJumping = true; });
117:   canvas.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'); // make focusable for key events
118: 
119:   reset();
120: })();

(End of file - total 120 lines)
</content>
